title: Double reinforcement.
officialText:
Plaster protection more than 1 inch (25 mm) in thickness shall be reinforced with an addi-
tional layer of approved lath embedded at least 3/4 inch (19.1 mm) from the outer surface and fixed securely in place.
Exception: Solid plaster partitions or where otherwise determined by fire tests.
